sections.heading: This week
paragraphs: Your food business is still bringing people in, and that is the good part. The thing that matters most this week is making sure the rent due in 9 days does not drain the business all at once.

You already know where the pressure is: cash comes in day by day, but the rent wants one big payment. So this week is about turning some of this week's sales into rent money, and asking for help on timing before the deadline.

sections.heading: What's working
bullets: People are already finding you through walk-ins, calls, WhatsApp, and delivery apps, so you do not need to start from zero.
About 2 out of 3 of the people who ask go on to pay you, which is strong for a food business that sells around Surulere.
You reply right away when people ask, so you are not losing them to slow answers.

sections.heading: Pay attention to
bullets: You said you do not follow up when someone does not order. That means some people who were still thinking may simply disappear.
The rent is due in one big payment, so even a healthy business can feel short of cash if the money is not set aside early.
Because you are getting about the same number of people asking and paying as before, the main risk is timing, not demand.

sections.heading: Opportunity
paragraphs: The biggest opening is to get more value from the people who are already asking you now. If you win just one more out of every 10 people who ask, that is 15% more paying customers from the people who already ask — with no extra marketing.

About 600 people ask in a normal month, so that is about 60 more paying customers a month. At about ₦2k–₦5k each, that is about ₦120k–₦300k more a month. That kind of money is enough to make the rent feel less like a shock and more like a planned payment.

sections.heading: Recommended actions
bullets: Call the landlord and ask for a split rent arrangement today.
List the customers who can pay ahead for meals or bulk orders, and contact them first.
Set aside every cash sale for the rent pot until the deadline.
When someone asks and does not order, send one short follow-up the same day with a simple prepay meal option.

sections.heading: Something to send this week
paragraphs: Hello [name], I’m taking advance orders for lunch and bulk meals this week. If you want, you can pay ahead today and I’ll set your meals aside for pickup or delivery. It helps me plan stock better and makes sure your order is ready on time.

sections.heading: What would sharpen this
paragraphs: The two numbers worth watching this week are how many people ask and how many of them actually pay. That tells you whether the fastest money is in asking more people to pay ahead, or in following up the ones who already asked.

It would also help to know how much cash you can set aside for rent each day between now and the deadline, because that shows whether the split-rent talk needs to happen urgently or can be backed by what you already have.
